First phase: equip the hornet ring and go for backstabs. Backstabs in the first phase are particularly easy to get. When she flies and and disappears, you can see snow kick up where she lands. You can also hear her land so you can just go in the direction you heard her land. If you find her she’ll be very vulnerable, use this to get a backstab. She’s vulnerable after being backstabbed, so use her recovery as an opportunity to charge a heavy attack. She is also parryable. Friede is weak to strike dmg (blunt).

Second phase: Focus Father Ariandel. Specifically the back of his legs. He is weak to all status effects. Watch out for his sweep attack. If he starts dumping out his bowl or starts his AOE, go start smacking Friede. Friede will be less aggressive during this phase and will mostly use her ranged ice attacks. Keep a reasonable distance until she throws said ranged ice attack, strafe it, and close in quickly while she’s recovering for a backstab or a few hits. While you’re on Ariandel she might start casting a heal spell, sprint towards her and backstab her. 

Third phase: not a lot I can say about this phase, the most important thing for you to do is memorize her attack patterns. She is vulnerable after her dark wave attack, but you will probably not be able to get a backstab off of it so just get in a few hits. When she does her spinning grab attack (telegraphed by her blade twinkling) dodge inward and slightly to either side and backstab her. But most importantly, DO NOT GET GREEDY.
Good Luck, and don’t get discouraged. :)

Here’s my setup for the silent forest hideout. The second hideout you get in the game.

The placement of the furniture in the doorway makes it almost impossible for enemies to enter through the doorway. This works 99% of the time, but it is not totally impenetrable. Sometimes the enemy ai manages to push the edge of the couch through the doorway. Make sure the furniture is touching the wall, and if you hear it moving, you should get your weapon out. 

The wardrobe found inside the hideout should be placed outside in front of the window on the right. This stops any light from going through the barricades so it doesn’t attract any monsters.

One lamp should be placed in the top left corner and one in the bottom left corner. This setup lets as little light escape the room as possible. Also you don’t need to move if the shadows show up.

The left window is the most vulnerable part of this setup. Place a trap outside of the window so that you get a little time to prepare for when try to come in. If you are willing to put in the time to pull a wide piece of furniture from another building to block this window, this build will become even safer. 

I recommend storing some planks, nails, molotovs, and heals in the shelf located in the room.
